note: 일상컷 트리 버전2(docs/CASUAL_TREE_V2.md) — 시대·장소·의상은 버전1 표(data/casual-tree.json)를 그대로 읽는다. 하는 일은 없고, 구도가 보이는 부위를 정한 뒤 몸 자세·받침·손(오른손·왼손 — 인물 본인 기준)·소품 동작·다리를 고른다. 자세 추천은 칸을 채울 뿐 지시문 문장을 갖지 않는다. 신화 공방 몫(2026-11-01, game 표에서 변환 — tools/casual-tree-v2-from-game.py): 게임 장소 → 신화 세계 장소(myth_*), 일터 · 공방 · 도장 · 제례 · 전설의 자리의 받침과 소품, 오락실 소품 · 휴대용 게임기 뺌, 시대 release → heritage.

expressions.calm: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile
expressions.focused: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed
expressions.soft_smile: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids

expressions.playful: asymmetric grin with teeth just showing, one brow raised, eyes narrowed with amusement
expressions.confident: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed
expressions.sensual: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth
expressions.provocative: challenging eyes under lowered lids, one brow raised, mouth corner tugged in a slight smirk

expressions.candid: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural

expressions.surprised: raised brows, widened eyes with visible upper white, mouth open in a small round shape
expressions.curious: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted
expressions.serious: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set
expressions.amused: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed
expressions.bored: lidded half-open eyes, slack mouth, brows flat and unengaged
expressions.pensive: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together
expressions.smug: one mouth corner lifted, lids lowered in a knowing look
expressions.gentle: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere
expressions.determined: brows pulled down and in, hard steady eyes, jaw clenched, mouth a tight line
expressions.exhausted: drooping lids and brows, dull tired eyes, mouth slightly open and slack
expressions.nostalgic: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends
expressions.unimpressed: flat level brows, half-lidded deadpan eyes, mouth in a straight unmoved line
expressions.flustered: raised inner brows, wide unsettled eyes, mouth slightly open, faint blush across the cheeks and nose
expressions.proud: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth
expressions.wistful: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised
expressions.mischievous: narrowed sparkling eyes, one brow up, closed-lip grin pushed to one side
expressions.relieved: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened
expressions.cold_smile: mouth smiling while the eyes stay flat and unsmiling, brows level
expressions.laughing: eyes squeezed nearly shut, mouth open wide with teeth showing, cheeks raised high
expressions.laughing_open: mouth open wide in a laugh with teeth showing and cheeks raised, eyes open and engaged with lids only slightly narrowed
expressions.wink: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed
